Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Shalini - 40 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The bathroom - Day

[Aarav stands in the bathroom. Shalini stands near him.]

Aarav: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Aarav brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Shalini: "Aarav, listen!"

[Aarav takes a quick bath.]

Aarav: "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Shalini: "So, here we are!"

[The sun rises over the village.]

Shalini: "And then?"

[The sun sets behind the trees.]

Aarav: "Exactly right."

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Aarav (softly): "One more time!"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Aarav: "And then?"

[A rainbow appears in the sky.]

Aarav: "Show me too!"

[The sun is blazing and Aarav is sweating.]

Shalini: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 3: The bedroom - Day

[Aarav stands in the bedroom. Shalini stands near him.]

Aarav: "So, here we are!"

[Aarav yawns loudly.]

Aarav (excited): "Let's see."

[Aarav stretches his arms above his head.]

Shalini: "And then?"

[Aarav goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Aarav (gently): "Okay, Mom."

[Aarav sits on the edge of the bed.]

Aarav: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
